🔥 The fire settles. Daniyar has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A dog-shaped silence at the treeline — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Cormac breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Nora says "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
